claims.claim: Ordinary first-party attempts select canonical AOA/TCA/MOA/ROA defaults, retaining two passes for AOA/TCA/MOA and one procedure for ROA.

Canonical authentication binds approval, R5 publication artifacts, pinned profiles, main, subject and return at ADMIT and CONTINUE, rejecting inconsistent or unavailable authority without V1/V3 fallback.
Independently authenticated exact-subject V1_ONLY and V1_READ_ONLY choices retain their permitted substitution and support behavior without dual normative audits.
Historical V1/V2/V3 replay and admitted profile/stage lineage remain preserved; changed continuations reject without profile reselection.
Audit support remains separate from direct-final authoring admission and Runtime, Reviewer and Publisher authority.

Integration tests exercise public attempt() and documentation describes the approved default. The repair corrects Windows newline translation in fixture Git input while retaining adversarial cases; 30 bounded development checks passed.
